_note: PER-SEAT CLI INVOCATION RECIPES as DATA. Consumed by bin/run-brief.py (the DRY-RUN planner). The LIVE executor that would shell these is GATED and NOT built (see pipeline-graph.md). Keyed by PROVIDER id (config/providers.json) so a resolved seat maps straight to how it is invoked. `bin` is the CLI binary the planner would shell (null for app/api/local seats that have no CLI). `wrappers` maps a registry route `host` to the wrapper CLI its recipes MUST render (bin + prefix + exactly one model_flag followed by the route's exact invocation_id); doctor derives the expected argv from here plus the provider's route — never from prose. Direct `claude` is auth_blocked and fails closed whenever the provider route is absent, unresolved, or not live_verified. Detection of the underlying Claude CLI still lives in providers.json `detect.cmd`. `args_template` tokens render from the brief with {placeholders}. `reads` = what the seat consumes (code seats read the git diff; Visual QA reads the preview URL — AGENTS.md §Review). `never_metered_host` is the hard invariant AS DATA: true = a subscription CLI (included) the executor may shell; false = a metered third-party inference host that must NEVER be handed a diff/brief (secrets/PII ban, EDGE-CASES.md) — included capacity or owner-land only. bin/doctor.py ties never_metered_host to providers.json `billing` and `bin` to `kind`, so this file can never drift from the registry. Nothing here is policy — providers/families/order/economics live in providers.json + usage-windows.json.

placeholders.{brief_path}: path to the 6-field brief file (paths only, no pasted dumps — AGENTS.md §Brief)
placeholders.{worktree}: isolated worktree dir for an implement lane (1 lane = 1 worktree = 1 branch — DOCTRINE §Concurrency)
placeholders.{branch}: the lane's branch (review reads its git diff)
placeholders.{repo}: repo root for a review seat that reads the diff in place
placeholders.{preview_url}: visitor preview URL a Visual QA seat walks

grok-build.note: Default implementer. Exact installed CLI contract: grok-4.6 at xhigh, one worktree / one branch / named file scope, no nested subagents; resume the existing branch on retry. grok-4.6-build is only the internal registry route key.

codex-terra.note: Google-MCP bulk fetches → output_path snapshot; implement runs against the snapshot.

codex-luna.note: Lightweight MCP/queue coordination helper. Never implements repo code; never a verdict.

codex-sol.note: OpenAI review family (cross-family gate #2). Verdict ship|fix-list|blocked; blocked wins. If Sol dispatched this run, review uses a separate invocation and is artifact-only; another reviewer must independently validate dispatch intent/risk.

args_template: review the git diff on {branch}; verdict ship|fix-list|blocked
opus-5.note: Anthropic gate (Opus 5). Invoked via teamclaude; direct claude is auth_blocked. If Opus 5 dispatched this run, review uses a separate invocation and is artifact-only; another reviewer must independently validate dispatch intent/risk.

args_template: review the git diff on {branch}; verdict ship|fix-list|blocked
opus-4.8.note: Opus 4.8 is a time-bounded Anthropic review fallback. Invoked via teamclaude; direct claude is auth_blocked. If it dispatched this run, review uses a separate invocation and is artifact-only; another reviewer validates dispatch intent/risk.

args_template: architecture pass on the git diff on {branch}
fable-5.note: Architecture / long-horizon only — OUT of the gating order. Invoked via teamclaude; direct claude is auth_blocked. Same family as Opus. Never a gating verdict; never the daily coder.

cursor-grok.note: First-party Cursor Models pool (included). IDE edits; drain before metered Cursor.

cursor-other-400.note: Metered $ 'Last $' pool. never_metered_host:false → the executor will NOT shell it; drains LAST, only when no included capacity remains (minimize API $).

grok-bot-review-d.note: Named Grok CLI agent. Launcher must prove the profile plus browser/pixel capability before execution; otherwise PARK. Reads a validated preview brief, never Slack.

grok-bot-heat-map.note: Named Grok CLI agent. Launcher must prove the profile plus signed-in Clarity/browser capability before execution; otherwise PARK. Feeds dispatch, never a verdict.

grok-bot-marketplace-intelligence.note: Named Grok CLI agent. Reads newly deposited approved snapshots or positively authorized API outputs only. Route stays unwired until profile sync plus a recorded one-time role test. Never a review verdict or implementer.

review-e.note: Metered independent-family review slot (off-box HTTP; unwired). never_metered_host:false → the executor NEVER hands it a diff/brief; its wrapper scans for secrets/PII first and it stays behind the owner-land guard. Never a Mini process.
